data.title: Install Pest Laravel Plugin
data.content:
Use Composer to add the plugin as a development dependency.

```bash
composer require --dev pestphp/pest-plugin-laravel
```

data.title: Create Pest test files with Artisan
data.content:
Generates new test files supporting feature, unit, and browser test types.

```bash
php artisan pest:test UserTest              # Feature test
php artisan pest:test UserTest --unit       # Unit test
php artisan pest:test LoginTest --dusk      # Browser test
php artisan pest:test UserTest --force      # Overwrite existing
```
